svg.title: EcoRefill revised user activity flow
svg.desc: Buying points and buying water share a machine QR scan. GCash purchases require owner approval before points are added. Users with insufficient points can buy points and return to their refill, rescanning if the QR expired. Recycling uses a separate reward QR.
svg.text: User / EcoRefill App — Revised Activity Flow
Scan the machine QR before buying points or buying water
